headline: Revenue grows, guidance raised as profit cools sequentially
summary_short: Q2 revenue rose to $2,177M, up 4.8% y/y and 4.3% q/q, while diluted EPS of $1.03 climbed 33.8% y/y but fell 15.6% q/q; Zimmer Biomet raised its full-year revenue and adjusted EPS guidance.
summary_long: Revenue was $2,177M (+4.8% y/y, +4.3% q/q), led by Technology & Data (+21.1%) and S.E.T. (+6.4%); Knees was roughly flat as International softness offset U.S. growth. Gross margin slipped to about 70.8% (-158bp q/q, -68bp y/y); operating margin fell to 15.0% (-291bp q/q) but rose y/y from 14.4%. Diluted EPS was $1.03, +33.8% y/y (aided by the absence of last year's $43.4M Paragon 28 vesting charge) but -15.6% q/q. Zimmer Biomet raised FY2026 reported revenue growth guidance to 3.9%-4.9% (from 2.5%-4.5%) and adjusted diluted EPS guidance to $8.47-$8.59 (from $8.40-$8.55). Cash fell to $410M; quarterly capex was $139.6M, free cash flow $308.3M.

drivers.explanation: Growth led by Technology & Data (+21.1%) and S.E.T. (+6.4%); Knees roughly flat as International softness (-1.5%) offset U.S. growth. U.S. sales +5.6%, International +3.7%.
Q2 2025 included a $43.4M accelerated-vesting charge tied to the Paragon 28 merger and higher acquisition-related costs; their absence this quarter lifted y/y EPS growth to 33.8%.
Management cited a strong first half, healthy underlying markets, on-track go-to-market changes and continued innovation momentum as the basis for raising full-year revenue and adjusted EPS guidance.
